bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 失守 $750，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Meta fell 3.3% on Oct 14 to $737.54, giving back the Oct 13 breakout. It closed just above its 5-day ($736.5) and 10-day ($733.9) averages and well above the 30-day ($700.2), 200-day ($631.4) and 100-day ($625.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 but the gap is narrowing and it is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 13 ($712.9), and RSI is 58.
read.zh: Meta 10月14日下跌 3.3%，收于 $737.54，回吐 10月13日的突破涨幅。股价收于 5 日（$736.5）和 10 日均线（$733.9）略上方，远高于 30 日（$700.2）、200 日（$631.4）和 100 日均线（$625.7）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，但差距收窄且在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看多（$712.9），RSI 为 58。

read.en: The close fell back below the $748–752 breakout zone (Oct 6 and 12 highs), which returns to resistance, with $771 (Oct 13 high) and the $780 record above. The day's low of $734.29 held the 5 and 10-day averages ($734–737); below them are $712 (SAR and Oct 8 low) and $700 (30-day average). A close back above $752 would target $771–780.
read.zh: 收盘跌回 $748–752 突破区域（10月6日和 12日高点）下方，该区域重新成为阻力，其上为 $771（10月13日高点）和 $780 纪录高点。当日低点 $734.29 守住 5 日和 10 日均线（$734–737）；其下为 $712（SAR 及 10月8日低点）和 $700（30 日均线）。若收盘重新站上 $752，目标看 $771–780。

r.en: Oct 6 and Oct 12 highs ($748–752), back to resistance
r.zh: 10月6日及10月12日高点（$748–752），重新成为阻力
